PERSON_NOT_FOUND.title: This person could not be found in EMDI
paragraphs: This can sometimes be corrected by EMDI support, who can explain how to add a new identifier to the record.
Please contact EMDI support using the 'report a problem' link above, and provide the CRN of the case you are trying to view and the Person Not Found error code.
bullets: The tag has been fitted within the last 48 hours. Please check again the next day.
The identifying information from Delius cannot be matched to identifying information in the EM data.

PERSON_NO_POSITION_DATA.title: No location data can currently be displayed by the tool for this case.
paragraphs: The tag itself may still be recording data and EMS may be able to provide access.
notMonitoredParagraphs: If the tag was fitted within the last 48 hours, it may not be providing data yet. Please check again the next day. Otherwise, contact EMDI support through the 'report a problem' link above, and provide the CRN of the case you are trying to view and the No Position Data error code so they can investigate.
monitoredParagraphs: To resolve the issue with data displaying in the EMDI tool, contact EMDI support through the 'report a problem' link above, and provide the CRN of the case you are trying to view and the No Position Data error code so they can investigate.
If you require this information urgently, please escalate your request through EMS.

PERSON_OUTSIDE_ORDER_PERIOD.title: This case is no longer available to view via this tool as the monitoring period is recorded as ended within Delius.
paragraphs: If you require information from before the end of the order, or if the person is still wearing a tag and you require their location data, you may be able to request this from EMS.

PERSON_NO_LOCATION_MONITORING.title: This case is available to view, however EMS does not have a location monitoring condition recorded as part of their GPS tag requirement.
paragraphs: The following conditions are recorded on this case: $enforceableConditions
If you think this is incorrect, please contact your regional EM team and ask them to add location monitoring as an enforceable condition to the record.

PERSON_NOT_TRIAL_REGION.title: This case is available to view, however EMS have recorded this person as being in $region which is not currently part of the EMDI pilot.
paragraphs: If you think this region is incorrect, please contact your regional EM team for help in updating this.
